terms.name: Metabolic Time
terms.def: How the Expanse counts time — by what bodies do: a Pulse Cycle, a Fugue Interval, a Beat, a Drift Season, a Tide. Organisms call it the Rhythm.

terms.name: Pulse Cycle
terms.def: About six seconds — one round of a fight, in which every organism takes its turn.

terms.name: Fugue Interval
terms.def: About an hour. A short rest, one leg of travel, or most of a scene takes one Fugue Interval.

terms.name: Beat
terms.def: A day: 24 Fugue Intervals, 20 of them lit and 4 of them dim. Wages, rent and rations are counted by the Beat.

terms.name: dim
terms.def: The four dark hours at the end of every Beat: curfew, sleep, and the time when smugglers, lovers and the night pumps move.

terms.name: Pulse Ten
terms.def: Ten Beats — the colonies' week. Three Pulse Tens make a Drift Season.

terms.name: Drift Season
terms.def: About 30 Beats — a season. Currents reroute and contracts rewrite. Each phase of the Tide lasts one Drift Season.

terms.name: Osmotic Tide
terms.def: The year: four Drift Seasons in which the whole world's saltiness swings — Isotonic Rise, Hypertonic Zenith, Isotonic Fall, Hypotonic Zenith — and every region changes with it.

terms.name: Great Cycle
terms.def: Sixteen Tides — a generation. At its end comes the Rereading, when registers are purged and old debts re-read.

terms.name: Isotonic Rise
terms.def: The spring of the Tide: the water is gentle, travel is cheap, and everyone signs contracts. Its festival is the Contract Fair.

terms.name: Hypertonic Zenith
terms.def: The salt season: the whole world turns salty and water leaves every body that cannot hold it. The dense rich thrive; the watery poor shrink. Its festival is the Salt Vigil.

terms.name: Isotonic Fall
terms.def: The autumn of the Tide: recovery, harvest and mourning. Its festival is the Rendering.

terms.name: Hypotonic Zenith
terms.def: The wet season: water floods into every body. The poor grow strong, the rich bloat, raids and swarms spread. Its festival is the Swell.

terms.name: Contract Fair
terms.def: The Isotonic Rise festival (3 Beats): debts signed, Oaths sworn, couples conjugate, offices are chosen for the Tide. An Oath sworn here costs nothing to swear.

terms.name: Salt Vigil
terms.def: The Hypertonic Zenith festival: fasting and rationing, water rights read aloud, the Deep Choir's long note, arrears audited and duels fought in the open.

terms.name: Rendering
terms.def: The Isotonic Fall festival (2 Beats): the year's dead are read by the Ash and rendered, so nothing of them is wasted, and their last memories are honoured.

terms.name: Swell
terms.def: The Hypotonic Zenith carnival (a Pulse Ten): masks are lawful, the poor rule the streets, current-races run, and every Issue the Pump backs starts stronger.

terms.name: Rereading
terms.def: Once every Great Cycle, every register is purged and every old debt re-read. The Unlisted may ask to be listed again.

terms.name: Hearth
terms.def: The shared warm heart of a household, hab or colony: where meals are eaten together, Rites are breathed and news is shared. Lower-case, a hearth is a registered household.

terms.name: Rite
terms.def: A ritual with chemical weight — a shared meal, a naming, a registration, a mourning. Rites change Cohesion, moods and standing.

terms.name: Chemotactic Rite
terms.def: A shared meal of rendered Substrate at a Hearth (1 Fugue Interval): it clears everyone's Stress, builds Cohesion and warms moods.

terms.name: Oath-duel
terms.def: A formal duel fought in the open to settle a sworn Motion. Killing either duellist is a crime, interrupting is a scandal, watching is a legal act.

terms.name: Long note
terms.def: The Deep Choir's pressure-song: one note sustained by Barophil throats for a whole Beat, sung at the Salt Vigil.

terms.name: Current-race
terms.def: The Swell's great sport: riding a channel current through a marked course of three checkpoints, with big bets.

terms.name: Masks
terms.def: Scent-masks hide what an organism is. Normally a crime against the Sacred Code's fourth Precept; lawful during the Swell.

terms.name: Stress
terms.def: Metabolic Stress: the fraying of a body's chemistry, marked on a track of 8. Too much slows you down; at 8 the body starts eating itself. Rest, a Vent or a shared meal clears it.

terms.name: Vent
terms.def: A hard exhalation of spent chemistry that clears some Stress at the cost of energy (ATP).

terms.name: ATP
terms.def: An organism's energy — what it burns to move, fight and work. Also a living currency: Host-Cities take their rent in it.

terms.name: Substrate
terms.def: Matter, and the Expanse's money, counted in S. A colonist's whole Beat of work is worth about 5 S.

terms.name: Cohesion
terms.def: How well a group's chemistry agrees, 0–10. A Cohort builds it by shared meals and kept promises; a colony has its own Colony Cohesion.

terms.name: Oath
terms.def: A promise folded into your own chromatin, so breaking it damages your body. The Expanse's whole social contract.

terms.name: Oath box
terms.def: Each organism can hold a few Oaths at once (one box each). An unspent box is a promise still waiting to be kept — and the Ash will not render a body with one.

terms.name: Ledger
terms.def: One page of who owes whom: owed to you, you owe, and who witnessed it. Every line is one sentence.

terms.name: Quorum
terms.def: How a colony decides: everyone who cares breathes signal into the Hearth air, and when the air is thick enough with one answer the whole colony knows it at once.

terms.name: Signal
terms.def: The molecule organisms breathe into the air to argue a Quorum. The rich can pay for more of it — 'breathing heavily'.

terms.name: Quench
terms.def: A political crime: an enzyme breathed into the air that destroys the other side's signal, so the Quorum is stolen. It leaves a residue that can be hunted afterwards.

terms.name: Issue
terms.def: A question before a colony's Quorum, argued on a track until the air reaches Quorum one way or the other.

terms.name: Convocation
terms.def: An argument in a room with three to six parties and one Motion on the table — a market, council, trial or treaty.

terms.name: Reveal
terms.def: A Convocation move: produce evidence — a witnessed line, a register entry, a memory — and win a step without arguing.

terms.name: Walk
terms.def: A Convocation move: withdraw from the room in front of everyone, so all must answer why you left.

terms.name: Yield
terms.def: A chemical white flag an organism cannot fake. Whoever kills a yielding organism marks Stress on every witness — so fights and duels can end.

terms.name: Assay
terms.def: A chemical trial: the Lysosome reads the accused's body for the truth, and the colony decides what the reading means.

terms.name: Unlisted
terms.def: An organism struck from (or never written into) the registers: no rights, no water ration, no lawful contracts, and invisible to every tax — which is why rebels and smugglers move through them.

terms.name: Register
terms.def: A colony's living record of who is 'self' — who belongs, with what lineage and Oaths. To be listed is to have rights.

terms.name: Dormant Cycle
terms.def: Six hours of true sleep in a safe nest or cyst: the long rest that restores a body.

terms.name: Dormant
terms.def: Unconscious: an organism with no Membrane Integrity left. A Dormant body is alive but cannot act.

terms.name: Frailty
terms.def: The weakness every lineage is born with, as much a social fact as a physical one.

terms.name: Literal
terms.def: The Immunan Frailty: they cannot be deceived by words and cannot deceive. Asked a direct question, they must answer truthfully unless an Oath forbids it — and even refusing hurts.

terms.name: Obligate Drifter
terms.def: The Flagellan Frailty: a Flagellan that stops moving loses its strength. They cannot hold a still post, and long stillness brings 'the ache'.

terms.name: Slow Reaction
terms.def: The Barophil Frailty: always a beat behind a fast room or a fast fight.

terms.name: Registered
terms.def: The Lysosan Frailty: every ward and gate can see they are 'not quite standard', so Wardens distrust them.

terms.name: Budline
terms.def: A family: everyone descended from one founding division. Budlines share a scent-root, a root name, debts and Oaths.

terms.name: Bud
terms.def: A new organism, made when a body divides. Buds are dependents until they come of age.

terms.name: Division
terms.def: How organisms reproduce: one body becomes two, and both remember being one — every memory up to that moment.

terms.name: Root-elder
terms.def: The oldest living member of a budline, who can call any member home once a Tide.

terms.name: Root name
terms.def: The ritual family part of a name — 'of the Seven Ladders' — given at the budline's Hearth.

terms.name: Ward
terms.def: A dependent taken in by Rite (Wardship) and raised as one's own. At gates, 'wards' are also the living sensors that read who is self.

terms.name: Plasmid
terms.def: A small, giftable sequence — a knack or habit (like a lullaby that calms the frightened), passed body to body at a Hearth. Giving one is the deepest courtesy.

terms.name: Conjugation
terms.def: Two organisms linking membranes and exchanging sequence: marriage, contract and shared inheritance at once, sworn at a Hearth before both budlines.

terms.name: Incubation
terms.def: Keeping watch while another organism takes its Dormant Cycle in the open — an intimate favour, because a sleeping body cannot mask what it is.

terms.name: Cleaner Pact
terms.def: A paid arrangement with a grooming guild that keeps parasites out of your membranes.

terms.name: Brooding
terms.def: Carrying a child, sequence or seed inside your own body across water it could not cross alone.

terms.name: Digestion Pact
terms.def: Selling your own future body to the Ash while you live: half its harvest value now, and they read and render you when you die.

terms.name: Memory strand
terms.def: A sealed crystal of an organism's recorded memories, kept as an heirloom or a last message. Some open only once.

terms.name: Trail-script
terms.def: Writing: scent laid down in sequence along a surface, read by following it.

terms.name: Condition
terms.def: Class, measured as concentration: the Dry (dense and rich), the Settled (the middle) and the Swollen (watery and poor).

terms.name: Dry
terms.def: The rich: dense, salted organisms living in sealed pockets kept steady by pumps others work.

terms.name: Settled
terms.def: The middle condition: a trade, a Hearth, a little saved.

terms.name: Swollen
terms.def: The poor: dilute, water-heavy organisms in the low, wet districts — strong in the wet season, shrinking in the salt.

terms.name: Hauler
terms.def: A worker of the Pump who carries water and goods uphill. A hauler earns about 4 S a Beat.

terms.name: Nursery
terms.def: Where a colony's young buds are cared for. In many colonies every hab must feed one nursery shift.

terms.name: Hab
terms.def: A dwelling cluster in a colony — a 'hab-hill' in the Mid-Strata can be the size of a hill.

terms.name: Sacred Code
terms.def: Seven Precepts enforced as law across the Expanse — for example, nothing crosses a colony's membrane unread; the dead must be harvested; you may not lie about what you are.

terms.name: Charter
terms.def: A colony's founding promises — or a licence that lets a band of adventurers work outside the membrane.

terms.name: Channel
terms.def: An illegal pore in a colony's membrane that lets goods (or water) leak through unread. Smugglers are 'channel-makers'.

terms.name: Host-City
terms.def: A Vast living organism that carries thousands of tenants in its body and migrates with the Tide. Rent is paid in ATP; its immune cells are the police.

terms.name: Rent Well
terms.def: Where a Host-City's tenants feed it their rent, one ATP a Beat.

terms.name: Organ
terms.def: A colony is a body with six organs — the Membrane, Pump, Vacuole, Nucleolus, Hearth and Lysosome. Every organism belongs to one.

terms.name: Membrane
terms.def: The colony's border organ: gates, registers, and who is let in.

terms.name: Pump
terms.def: The colony's labour organ: the haulers who carry goods and water uphill.

terms.name: Vacuole
terms.def: The colony's stores: water rights, rations and the treasury.

terms.name: Nucleolus
terms.def: The colony's council organ, which reads the Quorum and keeps the colony's sequence.

terms.name: Lysosome
terms.def: The colony's organ of waste, the dead and justice — where bodies are read, rendered and assayed.

terms.name: Assembly
terms.def: The colony's seven office-holders deciding ordinary business: fifteen voices, eight to pass.

terms.name: Porter
terms.def: The office that commands a colony's gates and decides who is read. Also a Warden rank.

terms.name: Registrar
terms.def: The office that keeps the register — entering and erasing who is listed — and witnesses every Oath.

terms.name: Tally-Keeper
terms.def: The office that sets and audits the water tally. If the tally fails, the colony can default.

terms.name: Tally
terms.def: The colony's tax and water account, assessed by hearth.

terms.name: Steward
terms.def: The office that feeds the colony from its store and can pay a poor household's arrears.

terms.name: Muster
terms.def: The office that calls the colony's militia.

terms.name: Printwright
terms.def: The office holding a colony's leased Hegemony print shop.

terms.name: Reader
terms.def: An Ash reader of the dead: they open their own body around a dead one and read its last memories.

terms.name: Quorum Speaker
terms.def: The organism trusted to taste the Hearth air and announce what the colony has decided. Not every Speaker is perfectly honest.

terms.name: Ribosome Hegemony
terms.def: The industrial power: foundries, licences and loans. It never breaks a contract in writing — it reinterprets one.

terms.name: Brine Office
terms.def: The Hegemony's waste-logistics desk — quietly its most powerful, because it decides who gets feedstock. It also lends money.

terms.name: Warden Circles
terms.def: The gate-keepers and register-keepers: 'nothing enters a colony that has not been read'. To be unlisted is to be outside their law.

terms.name: Flow Guilds
terms.def: The Flagellan currents-people: couriers, tolls and open water. They run the Currentpost.

terms.name: Reclaimers' Ash
terms.def: The faith and trade of the dead: they harvest and read bodies, believing an unharvested body is a soul wasted. They will not render a body with an unkept Oath.

terms.name: Sequence Underground
terms.def: The Lysosan-founded network of secrets, forgeries and hidden hosts.

terms.name: Deep Choir
terms.def: The Barophil faith of the world's slow hardening; they sing the long note.

terms.name: Currentpost
terms.def: The Flow Guilds' messages and passage along charted currents: one region a Beat, for a toll.

terms.name: Lipidpost
terms.def: The Ash's corpse-wagons: slow (a region a Tide) but impossible to search or stop, because censoring a funeral breaks the Sacred Code.

terms.name: Bridge post
terms.def: The Hegemony's registered mail on the Ribbon Bridges — reliable, and read.

terms.name: Lineage
terms.def: One of the six peoples of the Expanse, each a body plan and a politics: Amoeban, Epithalian, Flagellan, Lysosan, Immunan, Barophil.

terms.name: Amoeban
terms.def: 'The Unfinished': shapeless, flowing chemists, digesters and actors. Useful, never quite trusted.

terms.name: Epithalian
terms.def: 'The Walled': sheet-bodied builders, architects and contract-signers — the lineage others call civilisation.

terms.name: Flagellan
terms.def: 'The Rowed': finned, lashed swimmers born in the Great Flows — couriers, navigators, smugglers. They cannot keep still.

terms.name: Lysosan
terms.def: 'The Latent': library-bodies that carry sequences not their own — brokers, spies, archivists, distrusted by Wardens.

terms.name: Immunan
terms.def: 'The Registered': the lineage of recognising — wardens, registrars, witnesses. They cannot lie.

terms.name: Barophil
terms.def: 'The Hardened': dense, slow, pressure-proof extremophiles who outlast everyone; the Deep Choir's singers.

terms.name: Phenotype
terms.def: An organism's trade or calling — one of 24, like a class.

terms.name: Pheromological Messenger
terms.def: A Flagellan calling: carrier of words and scents across the water, and often a storyteller.

terms.name: Pathogen Scout
terms.def: A Lysosan calling: a scout who can slip through a region's defences unread.

terms.name: Kinetic Striker
terms.def: A Flagellan fighter whose speed seems to let it arrive twice: it turns Momentum into impact, and is the reason walls have short lives.

terms.name: Organism
terms.def: Every person in the Expanse is an organism — a single living cell-being.

terms.name: The Osmotic Expanse
terms.def: The world: an interior ocean of living chemistry — the Great Vesicle — where every person is a cell-being and every law is also physics.

terms.name: Sump Nine
terms.def: A poor salvage settlement of about 1,800 organisms at a channel mouth on the Fork of the Second Flow, where wrecks wash up.

terms.name: Second Flow
terms.def: A colony of 14,000 in the Mid-Strata, run by a water-tally council — and the name of the current it sits on.

terms.name: Fork of the Second Flow
terms.def: A branch of the Second Flow's current, running down to Sump Nine.

terms.name: Ash Rows
terms.def: Where a colony's dead hang in their husks, waiting for the Ash to read and render them.

terms.name: Gel moat
terms.def: A colony defence of thick gel; in Sump Nine the nursery sits at the warm bottom of it.

terms.name: Somatic gate
terms.def: A living gate that reads who passes and can be talked to.

terms.name: Cytoplasmic Mid-Strata
terms.def: The heartland: suspended colony-habs tethered by cables, home to most living organisms.

terms.name: Lysosomal Wastes
terms.def: The render-pit deserts where the Ash are strong and the dead are processed.

terms.name: Lipid Plateaus
terms.def: A desert of fat: pale congealed plateaus walked by Barophil herds.

terms.name: Tallow Market
terms.def: A floating bazaar on the Lipid Plateaus with no registers, where you can buy someone else's Oath — and be bound by it.

terms.name: Great Flows
terms.def: The great nutrient currents of the Expanse; the Flagellans' birthplace.

terms.name: Peri-Membrane Rim
terms.def: The edge of the world, where the outer membrane is close enough to feel.

terms.name: Knot Nine
terms.def: A city where seven Ribbon Bridges cross: a market and a courtroom.

terms.name: Ribbon Bridges
terms.def: Protein highways spun across thousands of Drifts; on a bridge, an Oath is enforced by the bridge.

terms.name: Old Mother Brine
terms.def: A great Host-City: a slow, motherly saline giant carrying thirty thousand tenants and the Flow Guilds' headquarters.

terms.name: Momentum
terms.def: The charge an organism builds by moving fast: +1 die and a stronger push on its next Strike.

terms.name: Vat Crew
terms.def: The Ash's hard-harvest labourers: unionised, dangerous work in the render vats. Rivals of the scholarly Ash Readers.

terms.name: Motion
terms.def: The one question on the table in a Convocation or Quorum — the thing the room must decide.

terms.name: Pressure
terms.def: A Convocation move: lean on someone with threat or status. It can win a rung — but if it fails, the room turns toward Hostile and the colony's Clock advances.

terms.name: Interior
terms.def: A colony's unrest, 0–8: its Stress. It climbs when organs die, when a Quorum is stolen, when strikes begin.

terms.name: Room mood
terms.def: A Convocation room has a mood — Hungry, Grieving, Hostile and so on — that helps moves which suit it and hinders moves which don't.

terms.name: Lisk-of-the-Seven-Ladders
terms.def: The narrator: a young Flagellan messenger who tells this tale at the Rendering.

terms.name: Oro
terms.def: Oro-of-the-Seven-Ladders: a Swollen Flagellan hauler of Sump Nine's Pump, ward of Sefa.

terms.name: Sefa
terms.def: Old Sefa: root-elder of the Seven Ladders budline, who leads the haulers' Hearth Rite.

terms.name: Seven Ladders
terms.def: A hauling budline of Sump Nine; its founder cut seven ladders up the sump's north wall.

terms.name: Mesk
terms.def: Mesk-of-the-Clean-Count: an Immunan, apprentice to the Registrar — and unable to lie.

terms.name: Quell
terms.def: Sump Nine's Registrar: a Lysosan struck from the register in a purge, who went on keeping it anyway.

terms.name: Varrow
terms.def: An Amoeban Ash Reader of great age and kindness.

terms.name: Yarrow
terms.def: Yarrow-who-went-ahead: a Lysosan Pathogen Scout whose body washes into Sump Nine's channel.

terms.name: Corvane
terms.def: Corvane of the Sealed Pocket: a Dry Epithalian who wants the empty Steward's office.

terms.name: Henn
terms.def: Sump Nine's frightened Tally-Keeper, behind on the colony's loan.

terms.name: Grue
terms.def: Sump Nine's Muster: a vast, slow Barophil who sings the long note.

terms.name: Dunmore
terms.def: A scarred old Barophil hauler of the Pump.

terms.name: Tannet
terms.def: The Epithalian keeper of Sump Nine's nursery.

terms.name: Ket
terms.def: Sump Nine's Porter: a stiff Immunan at the somatic gate.

terms.name: Wend
terms.def: Sump Nine's Quorum Speaker: an old Lysosan, honest enough most of the time.

terms.name: Lune
terms.def: A Hegemony factor from the Brine Office.

terms.name: Archivist Dol
terms.def: A register-keeper at Knot Nine, rumoured to erase entries for the Sequence Underground.

terms.name: Activation Threshold
terms.def: The number a pool must equal or beat.

terms.name: Affectives
terms.def: Status-signal speech.

terms.name: AE
terms.def: The golden catalyst that makes Bursts cheap; also *gold-tinted residue* in loot.

terms.name: Anchored
terms.def: Pathway rank 2.

terms.name: Antigen register
terms.def: A faction's list of recognised "self" chemistries.

terms.name: Apparatus
terms.def: A weapon or tool-organ.

terms.name: Autophagy
terms.def: Eating yourself for fuel.

terms.name: Baseline
terms.def: 3 × dice, the un-rolled success.

terms.name: Bands
terms.def: Contact/near/mid/far/loose distance zones.

terms.name: Bond
terms.def: A two-way chemical agreement between organisms.

terms.name: Breach
terms.def: Damage exceeding MI by 8+; instant Dormancy.

terms.name: Breach Overflow
terms.def: The amount you beat a Threshold by.

terms.name: Bulk
terms.def: Carried matter.

terms.name: Burst
terms.def: A catalytic procedure (magic).

terms.name: Catabolic
terms.def: Energy-starved condition.

terms.name: Catalysis
terms.def: The Pathway of Bursts.

terms.name: Catalyst
terms.def: An organism that uses Bursts.

terms.name: Codon
terms.def: Earned information; progression.

terms.name: Sustained Reaction
terms.def: A Burst you hold.

terms.name: Curator
terms.def: The Nucleoid's answer to overreach.

terms.name: Denatured
terms.def: Catalytic functions impaired.

terms.name: Detection Phase
terms.def: The contested scent roll before a Pulse War.

terms.name: Drift
terms.def: ~2 m of fluid, and the unit of movement.

terms.name: Enzymatic Pathway
terms.def: A learned skill, rank 0–4.

terms.name: Escalation
terms.def: Paying a higher Tier's cost for a known Burst.

terms.name: Expressed
terms.def: Pathway rank 1.

terms.name: Flow
terms.def: Your Drift speed; also current strength.

terms.name: Frequency Check
terms.def: Initiative.

terms.name: Gene-Debt
terms.def: The price a Relic takes.

terms.name: Gift
terms.def: A lineage's once-per-scene ability.

terms.name: Graft
terms.def: Installed alien biology; armour and organs; uses Slots.

terms.name: Grow
terms.def: Gain a Level.

terms.name: Harvest
terms.def: Extracting Specimens and Substrate from the dead.

terms.name: Hull
terms.def: Structural tradition, 3/4/6, part of MI.

terms.name: Runaway Catalysis
terms.def: No Inhibitors, two 6s.

terms.name: Inhibitor
terms.def: A rolled 1: costs attention, marks Stress.

terms.name: Latent
terms.def: Pathway rank 0.

terms.name: Legacy
terms.def: A successor organism built from the dead.

terms.name: Lysis Countdown
terms.def: Boxes to death.

terms.name: Lysis
terms.def: Death; your contents join the world.

terms.name: Membrane Integrity
terms.def: Hit points.

terms.name: Membrane Threshold
terms.def: How hard you are to connect with.

terms.name: Nucleoid
terms.def: The Core's centre; the AT 24 rung.

terms.name: Order
terms.def: One of the seven enemy traditions.

terms.name: Overflow
terms.def: See Breach Overflow.

terms.name: Overdrive
terms.def: Buying dice with energy or body.

terms.name: Parasitic graft
terms.def: A graft that chose you.

terms.name: Pathway
terms.def: See Enzymatic Pathway.

terms.name: Pulse Points
terms.def: Action economy per Cycle.

terms.name: Pulse War
terms.def: A fight.

terms.name: Reagent Pool
terms.def: The dice you roll.

terms.name: Reconstitution
terms.def: Short rest.

terms.name: Rejection
terms.def: Too many Slots.

terms.name: Relic
terms.def: A rule-breaking artefact with a Gene-Debt.

terms.name: Rider
terms.def: A Burst/weapon's extra effect on Runaway Catalysis.

terms.name: Scene
terms.def: One continuous situation with one purpose in one place: a Pulse War from Detection to its end, one negotiation, one leg of travel, one harvest. It ends when the place, the purpose or the people change, or after about one Fugue Interval (~1 hour). *Once per scene* resets then (§8.1).

terms.name: Segment
terms.def: A swarm body unit.

terms.name: Sovereign
terms.def: Pathway rank 4.

terms.name: Soak
terms.def: Damage reduction.

terms.name: Specimen
terms.def: Harvested genetic loot (C/G/P/T).

terms.name: Split Frequency
terms.def: Holding PP to act later in the Cycle.

terms.name: Stages I–IV
terms.def: Level bands 1/6/11/16.

terms.name: Symbiote
terms.def: A bonded living creature.

terms.name: Symbiosis
terms.def: The Pathway of bonds and command.

terms.name: Synthesis Choice
terms.def: The paid upgrade at each Growth.

terms.name: Tier
terms.def: Threat band, tied to Level bands.

terms.name: Tonicity
terms.def: Whether water wants to be inside you.

terms.name: Total Lysis
terms.def: Death.

terms.name: Vector
terms.def: A quest: a task that transmits you somewhere.
